scenes.time: Low red sun at the rim of the world, pigeon-breast sky, frost; later twilight on the ice (12 days pass)
scenes.key_moment: Wrack on the lip of the Well: black still water, a single white star far below, pale blue lantern jellies drifting (c04.s01.p003.1-6, c04.s01.p005.2)

backgrounds: Well lip at the top of the world, black water, jellies, glowing weed
Kettle House exterior with weed garden, washing line, workshop door, kettle on step
Ice above the house at red twilight
sprites: Jef (apron, jersey with hole in elbow)

scenes.time: Evening, lamp-lit (night follows; loft, window with jellies); text gives no clock time
scenes.key_moment: Jef turning Wrack's hands over under the lamp, knotted spotted old fingers on young ones (c04.s02.p010.1-4)

backgrounds: Kettle House interior: one long room, stove, mended table, jar shelves, box bed behind curtain
Loft with window onto jellies
expressions: Jef: grumbling, then fixed bright attention (c04.s02.p013.4)

scenes.time: By day (first morning, afternoons on the step); no light detail given

backgrounds: Kettle House workshop: heaped benches, lamps in pieces, pale warm wire, worn tools on wall
Kettle House step (afternoon talk)

scenes.time: No daylight; nine-hour descent in black water, then lit hospital halls; seven days of work
scenes.mood: vast, cold, then tender; strain; quiet triumph
scenes.key_moment: The Lantern's nine milk-glass halls ringed in black water like a crown of lamps (c04.s04.p007.1-3)

backgrounds: Well wall, black trench water, runner's small light
Lantern exterior: nine glass halls in a ring, covered ways
Lantern hall interior: high room, pools with gold glowing water
Dark dry hall
expressions: Jef: quiet, hand on cold glass (c04.s04.p013.2-3)

scenes.time: Night, low red sun turning on the rim; ice lit red through the sphere
scenes.key_moment: A sphere of water a hundred metres across hanging over the Well with a living shoal inside, red sun through it (c04.s05.p006.1-2)

backgrounds: Kettle House step and Well lip at night under low red sun
Kettle House interior (window with long ray shapes outside)

scenes.time: Day of thin fog, seventh week
scenes.key_moment: Anselm unhelming at the landing, broad white-haired man with thin pale scars from temples down his neck, rays all still facing one way (c04.s07.p004.1-3, c04.s07.p008.1-6)

backgrounds: Kettle House step in fog, landing, Well with stilled rays
expressions: Maelis: face shut like shuttered house (c04.s07.p005.2-3)
Anselm: calm, gentle, small smile (c04.s07.p025.4, c04.s07.p031.2)
Jef: very tired bright dark eyes (c04.s07.p049.3)

scenes.time: Night, lamp-lit; two months in; cold deepening
scenes.key_moment: Jef laying the worn tool on the table: small, shapeless, grip polished by nine hundred years of one man's fingers (c04.s08.p005.1, c04.s08.p006.1-3)

backgrounds: Kettle House interior at table, lamp
expressions: Jef: detached annoyance at his hand (c04.s08.p002.5)

scenes.time: Afternoon on the Well lip, then night in the workshop; later night of the dart; nine hours down, eleven under floor
scenes.key_moment: Jef dead beneath the Lantern's heart, one hand in the works, the other holding out the tool handle first (c04.s09.p044.1-5)

backgrounds: Well lip, jellies, nine-pointed star below
Workshop with cleared table, clean cloth, cold white light
Box bed by window
Doorway of Kettle House at night
Lantern cracked hall with dart in floor
Crawlway under the heart
expressions: Maelis: steady fingers, forehead against Jef's neck (c04.s09.p031.3-4)
Jef: dead, hand holding tool out (c04.s09.p044.4-5)

scenes.time: Day, then dusk with red twilight
scenes.key_moment: The Dragon departing at dusk with Maelis holding Jef, rays flying beside it like an escort of sails in red twilight (c04.s10.p011.1-3)

backgrounds: Kettle House step and shelf with Rime crowd
Landing at dusk, the Dragon, red twilight
expressions: Maelis: level, composed voice, seeming taller and further away (c04.s10.p009.2, c04.s10.p009.8)
